name: Tailscale
description: Tailscale is an identity-aware connectivity platform built on WireGuard that creates encrypted private networking between users, devices, services, and workloads, often as an alternative to traditional VPN architectures.
best_for: Best suited to developers, IT, and security teams that need simple private connectivity across laptops, servers, cloud networks, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and remote environments without exposing services directly to the public internet.
features: Encrypted WireGuard-based connections between authorized devices and workloads
Direct peer-to-peer paths when possible, with DERP relay fallback when direct connectivity cannot be established
Identity-based access policies, groups, device posture, and role controls
Automatic NAT traversal across common firewall and network layouts
Logging, flow visibility, and advanced access controls on higher tiers

alternatives.name: Cloudflare
alternatives.description: A broader network and security platform with Zero Trust access, private-network connectivity, CDN, and edge-security services.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations comparing private-access and Zero Trust connectivity as part of a wider network-security platform.

tiers.name: Personal
tiers.notes: Free forever for up to 6 users; includes up to 3 ACL groups, 50 tagged resources to start, and 1,000 ephemeral-resource minutes/month.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Unlimited users; up to 10 ACL groups and 1,000 ephemeral-resource minutes/month.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Up to 300 ACL groups and 10,000 ephemeral-resource minutes/month, plus advanced access, logging, and routing features.

cons: Personal is capped at 6 users, 3 ACL groups, 50 tagged resources to start, and 1,000 ephemeral-resource minutes per month.
Standard and Premium are priced per user, while tagged resources and higher ephemeral-resource usage can add separate cost.
Advanced controls such as just-in-time access, network flow logs, regional routing, and higher ephemeral-resource allowances require Premium or Enterprise.

faq.question: How much does Tailscale cost?
faq.answer: Personal is free for up to 6 users. Standard is $8 per user per month, Premium is $18 per user per month, and Enterprise is custom-priced.

faq.question: Does Tailscale always route traffic through its servers?
faq.answer: No. Tailscale attempts direct peer-to-peer WireGuard connections when network conditions allow. When a direct path cannot be established, traffic can use Tailscale's DERP relays.

faq.question: What limits apply to the Tailscale Personal plan?
faq.answer: The current Personal plan supports up to 6 users, up to 3 ACL groups, 50 tagged resources to start, and 1,000 minutes per month for ephemeral resources.

faq.question: Is Cloudflare a direct Tailscale replacement?
faq.answer: Not exactly. Cloudflare is a broader network and security platform. It is relevant when comparing Zero Trust access and private connectivity, but the architecture and surrounding product scope differ from Tailscale's mesh-network approach.
